# Super Agent Party (SAP)

Super Agent Party is an open-source, all-in-one AI companion platform. It integrates AI desktop companions (VRM/THA models), virtual streamers, IM bots, and smart home control into a single framework. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## What it does
- VRM/THA desktop companion with custom 3D/2D models
- AI task automation with desktop vision and PC control
- Multi-character group chat with SillyTavern card support
- IM bot matrix (Discord, Telegram, Slack, WeChat, QQ, Lark, DingTalk)
- Virtual streamer system (Bilibili, YouTube, Twitch)
- AI browser with autonomous web navigation
- Plugin ecosystem with MCP protocol support
- OpenAI-compatible API for developers
